contentReview.finding: Requested synchronous active-high reset; first output uses asynchronous posedge rst and negedge clk. Source structure alone does not prove correctness.

reviewedCorrection.summary: The reset and clock semantics have been corrected. The reset is now sampled only on the rising edge of the clock, and the counter is reset to 0 on the rising edge of the reset signal. The clock is not used in the sensitivity list, and the output of the counter is updated on every clock cycle. The module counter4 ports have been preserved.
